international.title: ‘Disaster’ unfolding as Sydney fire ant outbreak partly blamed on ignored biosecurity recommendations
international.summary: Farmers’ Federation president says Australia ‘can’t even keep [illicit] cigarettes out of the country … let alone some of these difficult-to-detect pests’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Years-old recommendations by Australia’s biosecurity watchdog have been ignored or not acted on by successive federal governments, increasing the risk of an invasive pest outbreak such as the fire ants discovered in Sydney this week, according to experts. Environmentalists and biosecurity experts warn the large colony of red imported fire ants are a warning sign that the country’s quarantine system is too slow-moving, underfunded and overly concerned with agriculture.
